description:
[Document requests] Ask a candidate for up to 10 documents (certificate, ID, reference...) with a message and due date. With notify (the default) the candidate is e-mailed. Use dry_run=true first: it shows whether the e-mail would go out (will_send, not_requested, no_valid_email, suppressed) and stores nothing.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

application_id.description: Optional: the candidate's application this is for (position_result.id); the e-mail then names its position.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

documents.description: The documents to ask for, 1 to 10.

dry_run.description: true: check everything and answer who would be e-mailed, without creating the request or sending anything.

due_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD), today or later. After it the candidate is reminded once by e-mail (when notify is true).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

message.description: Message to the candidate, at most 2000 characters.

notify.description: Default true: e-mail the candidate "Documents requested" now (and the one reminder after the due date). false: the request only shows on their application page.

name: request_candidate_documents
title: Ask a candidate for documents
